title: Mosaic Retail outbound + integration notebook
content:
Purpose / quick thesis:
- Quick scratchpad for Mosaic Retail (mid-market omnichannel retailer; 450 stores, ecommerce stack on Shopify Plus + custom OMS). Trying to map GTM/technical hooks for a pilot around embedding AI into store associate tablets and post-purchase support bot.
- Goal: short outbound + 4-touch sequence, technical meeting to confirm latency/SLA needs, propose a 6-week pilot (in-store POS assist + ecommerce chat).

Account snapshot (public + inferred):
- HQ: Denver. Revenue est: $300–500M. Private, growth-focused.
- Tech: Shopify Plus storefront, custom OMS (in-house), Zendesk for support, Segment + Snowflake for analytics.
- Likely constraints: PCI scope, PII handling for loyalty program, strict uptime during holiday windows.
- Champions: Director of Omnichannel (Sara Patel?) — listed on LinkedIn; Head of Digital (Tom W.) more engineering-focused.
- Procurement: tends to use annual contracts, legal triangle: risk/security + finance + merch ops.

Initial hypotheses on buyer pain: (to validate in discovery)
- Store associates need fast access to product info, current internal search is slow and inconsistent — could be a 2–3x improvement in time-to-answer using curated LLM + product catalog KV cache.
- Post-purchase tickets volume high for order status/replacements — could reduce ticket volume by 18–30% with a tailored chat agent and order-aware context passing.
- Embedding features (product recommendations, similarity search) for internal tooling to speed recommendations and cross-sell.

Technical fit notes / risks:
- Latency SLO: in-store tablet UI wants sub-300ms for autocompletion/lookup. If true, hosted API might need dedicated routing or private deployment in same cloud region. Confirm what "sub-300ms" means vs UI perceived latency (e.g., immediate suggestions vs full answer).
- Data residency: loyalty PII must be masked; propose token-level suppression and no KV cache of raw PII. We should position Redwood Private or dedicated capacity with KMS integration if they insist.
- Integration points: run small prepaid batch of product embeddings from Snowflake -> S3 -> Redwood embeddings endpoint for vector store build. Ensure embedding dimensionality and model compatibility.
- Edge case: SDK on their in-store tablets (iOS/Android webview) — need small footprint and robust reconnect/backoff.

Questions to confirm in discovery call:
- Main use case: associate assistance vs customer-facing chat? Prioritize order.
- Latency expectation for the UI (hard numbers) and peak queries/sec per store.
- Data they are comfortable sending to hosted API vs what must remain in VPC/on-prem.
- Typical ticket volumes and top ticket themes (to craft eval prompts).
- Any existing LLM/embedding pilots? (vendor names, lessons learned)

Objection handling cheatsheet (short answers to common pushes):
- "We can't send order data to a third party": offer Private deployment or Dedicated with no KV retention and KMS control. Outline minimal data approach (order id + hashed token + fetch-by-server-side) and sample audit log approach.
- "Latency will be too slow": propose pilot with dedicated pool in region and local prefix cache + continuous batching. Show sample perf numbers for similar customers (mean token latency X ms).
- "Cost is unpredictable": show Optimize recommendations: caching, dynamic quantization suggestions, and per-route caps. Offer simulated cost projection for 6-week pilot using their traffic profile.
- "We already use vendor X": ask what failed/succeeded; differentiate with production-first SLAs, rollouts, fine-grained routing and observability tied to prompt sets.

Outbound email drafts (A/B test):
- Short cold (for Director/Head):
Subject: Faster answers for store teams at Mosaic Retail
Hi Sara — quick note: we help retailers like yours cut associate lookup time and reduce post-purchase tickets (pilot customers saw ~20% fewer support tickets). Would love 20 minutes to share a low-effort pilot that connects your product catalog + orders (no PII stored). Is Tue/Thu next week possible?
—Aisha

- Technical outreach (to Head of Digital / Eng):
Subject: 6-week pilot: sub-300ms in-store lookups (no PII retention)
Tom — I looked at your stack (Shopify Plus + custom OMS). We can run a lightweight pilot: S3 snapshot of catalog -> embeddings -> edge-configured model with prefix caching. Typical outcome: sub-300ms median lookups and a 30% reduction in associate time per lookup. Can I book 30m to walk through architecture and cost?
—Aisha (cc: Marco Ruiz)

Follow-up cadences (skeleton):
- Day 0: email variant A or B.
- Day 3: short Slack/LinkedIn nudge (if contact public).
- Day 7: value-add doc (1-pager: 'In-store LLM quickstart for retailers').
- Day 14: ask for 10-min discovery; include two proposed times.
- Day 30: last-touch with reference case + 'if not now' note.

Pilot proposal outline (6-week):
- Week 0: kickoff, NDA if needed, define eval prompts/metrics (time-to-answer, ticket deflection %, CSI).
- Week 1: data extract + embedding build; minimal transform scripts (we provide templates).
- Week 2: integrate store UI + test harness for latency.
- Week 3: internal QA + small shadow traffic run.
- Week 4–5: live pilot (10–20 stores) + telemetry dashboards (latency, per-route cost).
- Week 6: Retro + proposal for rollout or Dedicated capacity.

Customer references to mention (anonymized blurbs):
- "Reduced store rep lookup time by ~35% and improved conversion at POS" — national home retailer
- "Cut ticket volume by 22% on post-purchase issues in 8 weeks" — omni cosmetics retailer

Meeting note template (for discovery):
- Attendees, roles, decision timeline?
- Current flows (associate lookup, post-purchase flows).
- Volume, P95 latency requirement, SLA expectations.
- Data classification: what can be sent? what must stay?
- Security ask: KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2?
- Success criteria & next decision steps.

Open items / TODOs:
- [ ] Pull publicly available Mosaic FY data (sources + link) — Jenna
- [ ] Create 1-pager ‘In-store LLM quickstart for retailers’ (template from Confluence MOS-quickstart) — Marco
- [ ] Ask engineering for sample perf numbers for small catalog + per-store concurrency (SRE ping: @sre-team) — Aisha by 2026-02-25
- [ ] Draft pricing projection for 6-week pilot (low/medium/high usage) — Finance stub JIRA-MKT-1427

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness):
- Try LinkedIn intro through Sara's ex-colleague (mutual: Emily Tran) — may increase response rate.
- Emphasize cost controls early; retail buyers hate surprises.
- If they insist on on-prem: prepare one-slide summary of Private deployment timeline (2–4 weeks infra prep + agent install).

End of notebook.
